cases.purpose: Reject out-of-range GPT entry locations without overflow, false partition tags, or shell failure.
cases.oracle: The table LBA overflows 64-bit byte offset multiplication to zero; sentinel nonzero bytes at offset zero must never be treated as a partition entry.
cases.comparison: Exact output and status, including shell survival.
cases.setup_script:
mkdir -p dev sys tree/disk tree/disk/disk1
ln -s ../tree/disk/disk1 sys/disk1
printf '1\n' > tree/disk/disk1/partition
python3 - <<'PYFIX'
import struct
from pathlib import Path
p=bytearray(65536)
p[0:32]=bytes(range(1,33))
p[512:520]=b'EFI PART'
struct.pack_into('<QII',p,584,1 << 55,128,128)
Path('dev/disk').write_bytes(p)
Path('dev/disk1').write_bytes(bytes(4096))
PYFIX
cases.script:
export BASHBLKID_SYS_BLOCK_DIR=$PWD/sys BASHBLKID_DEV_ROOT=$PWD/dev
blkid -s PARTUUID -o value "$PWD/dev/disk1" || exit 1
printf 'survived\n'
